title: governed: two skills still call `titleFormat` "deprecated, not removed", and ADR-0079 D3 still says "advisory, not an error", after #29007 refused it
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Filing gate: ② text drift on governed paths, named by the spec seat's contract review of PR #29499 (#29007). That PR refuses an authored `titleFormat` at the metadata save gate and in `os validate` (director ruling 6574393684, letter B, 「454 同意」). The PR's claim cannot touch governed files. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## What still says the old rule (read on PR #29499's head `08859318`; re-read on `main` once it lands)

- `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:90`: "Deprecated, not removed".
- `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md:444`: the same deprecated-but-accepted reading.
- ADR-0079 D3: "advisory, not an error". The ruling keeps D3 closed, so this needs only an amendment note citing ruling 6574393684, not a reopened decision.

Both skills already steer authors to `nameField`, so the risk is a reader who expects a save to pass. Nothing silently breaks.

## Done when

- The two skill lines say a save and `os validate` refuse `titleFormat` with the prescription to move it to `nameField`.
- ADR-0079 carries a dated amendment note at D3 citing ruling 6574393684 and PR #29499.
- This is Tier H/S governed, so it lands only after a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval.

Blocked-by: #29007 (PR #29499).
Dedupe: searched `titleFormat skill deprecated`, `ADR-0079 D3 advisory`: none. **New.**
